checks: published signed wire and public identity
canonical hash and personal signature compatibility
curve-order prehash boundaries n-1, n, n+1 and maximum recover the correct identity

initial_test_observation.finding: Universal byte equality was an invalid assumption: native nonce seeding reduces prehashes modulo the curve order, while k256 0.13 uses unreduced bytes. Both signatures remain valid; the boundary tests require the correct signer identity.

scope: Executable signature/protocol compatibility; not a constant-time or whole-cryptosystem proof.
